title: Seance — privacy demo
summary: Read-only browser comparison of what strangers, recipients and auditors can learn from private Esmeralda payments. October 29 inspection confirmed the initial example is explicitly a saved October 20 copy, even while the request mode says Live. A separate Summon a recent transaction action returned Commit for 17d6b433db0d47106f90c5d84460a984166bd057969ff751dc8a22cc72cacb7e; that is a public indexer read, not a payment we sent. Public demonstration keys opened the saved memo and counted amounts locally. The refreshed recording shows that saved-example mode. Timing, fees and the spend graph remain visible; the Poltergeist comparison uses eleven recorded payments and a synthetic transparent ledger. Audit search is bounded to 0–0.0005 SEANCE. Source at 0642c4ad5fc1; no personal keys or wallet actions used. Distinct from DevXTools’ sealed-poll project.
cardSummary: Compare what strangers, recipients and auditors can read from private testnet payments, including the metadata that remains public.
creator: Kylne700
